comparison.object_projection: Compare Wanted keys; ignore extra observation metadata. Want empty object{} is an empty object value. /maps/A and /maps/B compare complete sorted key sets and values.
comparison.arrays: Ordered items and exact lengths; distinguish null from empty array.
comparison.scalars: Compare JSON types and literal values. Numeric representations follow the fixed worker's integer JSON output; no float64 conversion.
comparison.missing: Unknown with field-present=false; never treat a missing field as explicit null or automatically false.
comparison.getter_unavailable: For request0, getter_available=false or absent/invalid masks getter_values, key_present, getter_error and mutated_getter_result, including snapshot getter channels. Setter errors and known flag state remain independently comparable.
comparison.error_unavailable: error.available=false or absent/invalid masks that error object's Wanted predicates. Error kind_available=false masks only kind. A known wrong type instead of an error object is a known mismatch.
comparison.flag_identity_unavailable: For request5, flag_identity_available=false or absent/invalid masks the root flag_name channel.
comparison.metadata: Wanted message_observed=false/message:null is observation metadata equality, not evidence of zero original nested Error calls.
comparison.row: Any known false => unsatisfied while preserving unknown predicates; every Wanted predicate known true => satisfied; otherwise unknown.
comparison.candidate: Preserve ordered five/six-row vectors, row ordinals, known counterexample fixture positions and all fixture positions containing unknown predicates. Aggregate uses the same false-first three-state rule.

input_binding: Regular bounded files; exact catalog bytes+SHA and explicit exact saved-result SHA; exact IDs/positions/counts and complete unqualified observation header. Duplicate JSON keys, trailing data, invalid UTF8 and bounded structural excess are rejected.
authority: Finite satisfied/unsatisfied/unknown only. Labels, roles, qualification and adoption belong to Root. Source-basis hash is a declared reference; this comparator does not establish external native Start/Wait, journal, compiler or binary proof.
comparator_author: checkpoint_native_peer_114; independent of candidate/Want/source authors, but author of this comparator; Root source review required before actual comparison
